verdict.rationale: AutoGen has no built-in versioning, but the evidence makes automations portable artifacts that can be tracked in an external tool like git. Teams can be defined declaratively as JSON in AutoGen Studio, components can be serialized and deserialized, and teams can be exported as Python code. Review and rollback would rely entirely on outside tooling. Missing for 10: built-in version history, diff/review workflow for automation changes, one-click rollback to prior versions, and independent corroboration of a versioning workflow.
